lede: The sharpest item this week is Thursday's San Miguel County Planning Commission meeting, where proposed amendments to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee — LUC Section 5-1303 — are on the table alongside broader housing incentive ideas; how that fee gets structured will shape what workforce housing actually gets built here. SMART's board also meets Thursday to vote on resolutions including a federal Capital Investments Grant comment and an amendment to the Executive Director's employment agreement, with a gondola project update in the mix. On the lighter side, the KOTO Ski Swap kicks off Friday and the Ridgway Independent Film Festival runs through the weekend.

notable.stake: Proposed fee changes to Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation could reshape workforce housing county-wide.
Board votes on final open winter vending permit for Gondola Plaza West.
SMART votes on federal grant program comments and Executive Director employment amendment.
